items.headline: Barclays: Asia data-center debt binge is hitting banks' lending limits
items.note: Barclays' Asia-Pacific loan syndicate head says regional lenders are already heavily exposed to data centers and growing selective, with banks unable to absorb the financing volume the buildout will need — a concrete sign lenders are pulling back, not just commentary.

items.headline: Nvidia invests $3.5B in MediaTek convertible bonds, reigniting circular-financing scrutiny
items.note: Nvidia's first direct stake in a Taiwanese IC designer drew fresh circular-financing criticism (chipmaker funding a partner that buys its own platform tech) and knocked Nvidia shares down ~4.5%, though no credit metric (CDS, rating, spread) moved on it.
